name: cap_closes_the_pipe
why: ENTRY Z-C6. `end_cap` was in the catalogue with `Provata = true` and no bench run touched it. Measured on 25/9/2026: it works, and the volume it adds can be counted by hand to the mm3.
defect_caught: The cap that is born on one end only, or outside the tube instead of inside. Two caps inside give +42250 mm3 and three bodies; a single one would give +21125, and a cap resting outside flush (80 x 80) would give +32000 each.

expect.tolerance_why: 600 mm x 1469.956 mm2: the section of the tube has the corner radii, so pi inside

expect.why: an open bar has two ends, and it caps both of them
the cap is a body of its own, as in the workshop: the bar plus two plates

expect.tolerance_why: 881973.45 + 2 x 65 x 65 x 5 = +42250 exactly: the cap sits INSIDE the tube (inner opening 70) with half a wall thickness of clearance per side, so 65 x 65, and it is a square without radii. The tolerance is that of the bar, which has pi inside
